خؤور: خَؤُورٌ : see the next paragraph, in two places.
خؤولة: خُؤُولَةٌ The relationship of a maternal uncle [and of a maternal aunt]: (JK, S, K, TA:) an inf. n. (JK, TA) having no verb. (TA.) You say, بَيْنِى وَ بَيْنَهُ خُؤُولَةٌ [Between me and him is a relationship of maternal uncle]. (S, K.) ___ Also a pl. of خَالٌ in the first of the senses assigned to the latter above. (Msb, K.)
